title: DeepSeek Web API: Using OpenAI SDKs with DeepSeek Models
metaDescription: Access DeepSeek models using OpenAI SDKs with the unofficial DeepSeek Web API. A self-hosted browser proxy for API translation. Includes setup guide.

h2: What Is the DeepSeek Web API?
Setting Up the DeepSeek Web API Locally

structuredData.headline: DeepSeek Web API: How to Use OpenAI SDKs with DeepSeek Models
structuredData.description: The DeepSeek Web API project enables developers to interact with DeepSeek's large language models using standard OpenAI API libraries. By leveraging browser automation, it creates a local proxy that translates API requests into web interface interactions, offering a creative workaround for accessing language models without native API support.
